about: Countdown put on a new summon while its summoning animation plays; esv::summon::AnimationSystem (per-frame update bg3.exe+0x2DC9410; Toolkit WorldView<summon::AnimationRequestComponent, eoc::animation::GameplayEventsOneFrameComponent const, eoc::summon::AnimationComponent const>) decrements it and removes the component when it reaches 0. Seen.py context: born in 'spells-5' (summoning spells) and fights with summoning enemies.

evidence.says: Creator bg3.exe+0x2DC9B10 writes 0x40C00000 (6.0); Toolkit esv::summon::AnimationSystem::Update also writes 0x40C00000, then does value -= frame delta (GameTime +8) and calls RemoveComponentUnchecked when value <= 0. Live: 6.0 and 1.739.

survey.raw_check: 2 instances, se-fork/coverage/check.py raw stage, game v4.76.31.656
